existingResolutionContains: Block-local sorted id-to-pubkey, id-to-blockhash and block-id-to-vote-hash tables.
Per-transaction signature counts, current blockhash and actual previous blockhash.
Parent slot, source schemas, exact hot/signature offsets, source object lengths and strong ETags.
existingResolutionOmits: Raw ordered signature bytes; these remain in the source signature file.
existingAccessBlobContains: Current and previous blockhash, per-transaction signature counts, ordered raw signatures, and all three block-local dictionary tables.
existingAccessBlobOmits: Source locator, explicit slot, parent slot and schemas. A service must add or bind the needed descriptor. The hot header has slot and parent slot, which must match the descriptor.
concurrencyLimits: The block and resolution requests can overlap after the caller or endpoints have a trusted slot-to-source locator.
The current plain access=0 Worker path still loads its R2 resolution before the hot GET; a new disk service alone does not remove that hidden lookup.
The existing signed client locator authenticates the source descriptor, not an arbitrary submitted dictionary payload. Keep a trusted service response or a signed full content digest.
unmeasured: Disk service implementation, local directory lookup, local file reads and file-cache effects.
Service network path, response compression and transfer time, concurrency, cold process starts and availability.
CPU, throughput, egress and fixed monthly server cost.
Complete two-source client download and JSON reconstruction parity/time against independent RPC output.
costLimit: Moving the access record to a server replaces object operations with server I/O and transport. It does not prove a lower all-in cost or latency. R2 hot GETs and Worker/auth CPU remain if the public Worker is still used.

limits: Raw uncompressed ID bytes only; add counts, slot/source identity, parent/hash and range descriptor headers.
Only four modern blocks measured; all have zero vote IDs.
No service implementation, full epoch size or latency measured.
